subject: soccer moms
one_liner: A bargain marketplace for soccer moms who came to watch the game and stayed to finish the offer.
brand_voice_notes: Apply the frozen anti-ai-slop skill. Write plainly and keep a straight face. The parent wants to save money and support her child; shopping gradually wins her attention. Let small discounts produce visible social consequences. Keep controls literal. Catalogue prices, promotions and customer accounts are fictional concept data. Pricing tiers are merchandise bundles purchased once, rather than software subscriptions.
demo_screen_concept: One marketplace screen shows sideline chairs, coolers, umbrellas and phone holders in a product grid beside a working cart. The selected $8.40 chair has a team-color selector, customer photographs and an Add to cart button. An Offers panel opens a coupon wheel with Spin and Apply coupon controls. Completing the sample offer awards $1.20 off; a small match update then reports that Maya scored while the offer was open. A reachable Free cooler panel shows four completed referrals and one pending invitation to Paula, whose child plays for the opposing team. Completing the sample invitation reveals Paula's message: 'Done. Great save from Oliver!' A Reviews panel contains two prepared photographs of the chair: a wide shot with Maya holding a trophy and a close crop showing all four cup holders. Selecting the close crop produces a review preview with Maya entirely outside the frame. Keep the cart, discount and final total consistent. Use plain navigation labels: Shop, Offers, Invitations and Reviews.

hero.h1: Your kid scored. You won a coupon.
hero.sub: Rally sells cheap chairs, coolers and sideline gear to soccer moms. Spin for discounts, invite other parents for free gifts and turn the post-match trophy photo into a chair review.

features.title: Try for a better discount.
features.blurb: Spin the coupon wheel during the match. Your daughter scores while you're trying to turn 80¢ off into $1.20. You ask her to do it again after checkout.

features.title: Invite five parents.
features.blurb: Get five new shoppers to sign up for a free cooler. The fifth is the opposing goalkeeper's mother. You hug her for completing the offer just as her son saves your daughter's penalty.

features.title: Show the product clearly.
features.blurb: Earn your next coupon with a photo review of your new chair. Move your daughter and her trophy aside so all four cup holders are visible. The chair gets a solo portrait.

candidates.premise: Sideline shopping offers become more absorbing than the child's match.
candidates.audience_behavior: A parent feels responsible and resourceful when she finds a bargain, and keeps pursuing it after the saving has become trivial.
candidates.source_mechanic: Coupon games, referral gifts and customer photo reviews attached to a low-price marketplace.
candidates.comic_turn: She records the coupon instead of the goal, celebrates with an opponent's parent and gives the chair a better portrait than the player.

candidates.premise: An encouraging parent launches a merchandise range before her child has decided whether to keep playing.
candidates.audience_behavior: A parent expresses belief in a child's potential through increasingly public displays of support.
candidates.source_mechanic: Personalized products, coordinated recommendations and bulk discounts.
candidates.comic_turn: The child asks to try swimming while the parent is distributing products bearing a soccer career that lasted six Saturdays.

candidates.premise: Every parent buys equipment to avoid asking another parent for help.
candidates.audience_behavior: Parents want to look prepared and dislike being the person who forgot something.
candidates.source_mechanic: Frequently bought together suggestions, quantity deals and minimum-order incentives.
candidates.comic_turn: A sideline full of duplicate shelters, wagons and chargers still has to borrow the coach's scissors to open the packaging.

angle_selection.selected_premise: Sideline shopping offers become more absorbing than the child's match.
angle_selection.reason: The conflict is immediate: she came to watch her child, but the bargain keeps demanding another action. Three recognizable marketplace mechanics produce different consequences involving attention, loyalty and family photographs. The merchandise premise depends more heavily on parental ambition; the preparedness premise risks repeating the recent digest's storage and overbuying jokes.

observations.behavior: A parent pursues a tiny additional saving while believing she is making good use of time beside the field.
observations.mechanic: A coupon wheel offers another attempt before the shopper applies a discount to her cart.
observations.consequence: The shopping victory displaces the child's actual achievement, and the parent asks for an unrepeatable goal to be performed again.
observations.landing_callback: The hero contrasts the goal with the coupon. The feature introduces the request for a repeat performance; Lauren's testimonial reveals that the supposed match recording contains only the shopping game.
observations.demo_callback: After the sample coupon is claimed, a match notice reports Maya's goal. The saved activity record contains the coupon result and no goal video.

observations.behavior: A parent treats other parents as a dependable network for small favors, then exhausts that network chasing a free item.
observations.mechanic: A referral gift requires five new shoppers, with visible progress and individual invitation states.
observations.consequence: She recruits an opponent's mother and celebrates the signup during her own child's sporting disappointment. Her shopping alliance outlasts her team's tournament.
observations.landing_callback: The referral feature places the hug at the saved penalty. Monica's testimonial extends the alliance into a drive home after elimination because another signup is still available.
observations.demo_callback: The fifth invitation identifies Paula as an opposing-team parent. Her completion message celebrates her son's save, putting the shopper's reward beside her daughter's disappointment.

observations.behavior: A parent habitually photographs family achievements and also wants credit for a successful purchase.
observations.mechanic: A photo-review offer rewards a clear picture of the purchased product.
observations.consequence: The product's documentation takes priority over the child's trophy, and the family photo collection begins to resemble a furniture catalogue.
observations.landing_callback: The feature gives the chair a solo portrait. Beth's testimonial adds the child's objection to having sporting achievements published through product reviews.
observations.demo_callback: The review panel offers a trophy photograph and a tighter product crop. Selecting the crop makes the cup holders prominent and removes Maya from the published preview.

source_product_patterns: A dense, image-led marketplace grid with low prices, product variants and direct routes to product details.
Product detail views combining photographs, color choices, ratings and customer photo reviews.
A persistent cart with quantities, applied discounts and a clearly calculated order total.
Gamified coupon discovery that asks the shopper to complete another action before returning to checkout.
Referral offers with an invitation link, a required number of new shoppers and visible progress toward a gift.
Related sideline products and merchandise bundles that preserve a shopping service model.
editorial_plan.composition_plan: Primary action: Shop sideline gear. Recognizable product visual: a chair listing, product grid, open coupon offer and adjacent cart. Open with the Rally identity and a small the worst AI studio ever credit, followed by the headline, explanation and CTA. Put the working marketplace preview immediately below, large enough to read the chair price and coupon result together. Follow with three feature passages, customer incidents and a joined comparison of merchandise bundles. Proposed artwork one shows a mother absorbed in her phone in the foreground while her daughter celebrates a goal behind her; its purpose is to establish the competing claims on her attention. Proposed artwork two is a contact sheet from the same post-match session: the daughter and trophy gradually leave the frame while the chair becomes perfectly centered; its purpose is to make the review-photo consequence visible. Individual chair, cooler, umbrella and wagon packshots are selectable catalogue content. Keep prices, offer progress, messages and review text live. On mobile, place the selected product before the cart and open supporting panels in the same column. Compared with the recent digest, the engine is attention captured by small rewards, favors crossing sporting loyalties and family memories becoming retail evidence. Merchandise bundles avoid repeating subscription escalation, installation quotes or collection growth. In the green invitation section, keep the demo link chalk white, brighten it to white with a heavier underline on hover or keyboard focus, and use a chalk-white focus outline. Preserve the section layout.

references.reference: Youth-soccer picture-day order envelopes and team-photo contact sheets
references.cues: Confident package headings, rectangular photograph windows, numbered choices, team-color bands and clear parent-facing purchase information.
references.application: Use broad, friendly Barlow Semi Condensed headings with Nunito Sans body text. Organize the bundle comparison like a picture-package order sheet. Frame customer photographs as original contact-sheet sequences without copying an organization's logo or layout.

references.cues: Orange wedges in clear tubs, blue coolers, white price strips, grass around folding chairs and practical equipment arranged within arm's reach.
references.application: Use chalk white #F8FAF5, field green #265B43, cooler blue #246582 and orange #C44B20. Give catalogue objects bright daylight and simple backgrounds. Use blue for primary actions and orange sparingly for offer status.

references.reference: Tournament sideline rows viewed from behind the parents
references.cues: Repeating folding-chair backs, clipped umbrellas, bags under seats and a clear view toward a small playing field.
references.application: Use horizontal chair-height divisions and landscape documentary photographs. Keep the child and field visible in campaign imagery so the reason the parent came remains apparent.

audience_design.landing_application: Build a bright Saturday-morning sports identity with compact display headings, readable rounded body type and broad white areas bounded by green rules. Use one large marketplace preview rather than a wall of decorative cards. Alternate open feature passages with the two purposeful photographic compositions. Present pricing as a parent-facing merchandise order sheet, with the contents and total visible together.
audience_design.demo_application: Retain the source marketplace structure: search and categories above a product grid, product details with variants and reviews, a persistent cart, and reachable offer and invitation panels. Apply the same green rules, blue actions, orange offer markers and daylight product photography at a denser scale. Use plain labels and readable totals. Team-photo framing belongs around review content; it must not obscure product controls or turn the shopping workflow into a sports dashboard.

design_direction.style: Picture-day sports retail: friendly condensed package headings, white order-envelope panels, broad field-green rules and cooler-blue shopping actions.

palette.name: Saturday Field, Cooler and Orange Wedge

fonts.pairing: Bundled Sports/Fitness condensed display hierarchy adapted to the approved Barlow Semi Condensed and Nunito Sans parent-facing picture-day pairing.

design_direction.archetype: Marketplace product preview followed by open behavior-led features, composed campaign art, customer incidents and a picture-package merchandise order sheet.
design_direction.motion_vocab: 150ms color feedback, user-triggered wheel rotation, immediate truthful cart updates; reduced-motion disables rotation.
design_direction.hero_composition_notes: Headline and action form a compact broad opening above a live marketplace preview: chair packshot and variants, coupon offer and cart together. Supporting campaign compositions follow product evidence.
design_direction.design_review: Compared all seven host digest entries. No matching style/palette/font tuple. Chair-back cutout motif, picture-day package blocks and white sideline retail differ from bridge bands, poultry prizes, railway stock bays, yearbook portraits, cupboard shelves, salvage tags and album sleeves. Approved audience colors and fonts supersede automatic family-blue library palette.

brand_kit.identity_rationale: Rally takes its identity from youth-soccer picture-day envelopes and rows of folding chairs. A bespoke forward-leaning wordmark and folding-chair/flag hybrid symbol connect shopping ambition to the sideline. The coupon becomes the parent’s competing sporting achievement.

logo.concept: Selected Gemini direction A: bespoke exact Rally wordmark and folding chair with cheering pennant. Chair and flag unite watching and celebrating; generous letter separation preserves the name at navigation size. Direction B combines a perforated coupon and chair but its joined lowercase forms are less clear at small size. Monochrome recolors accepted pixels; icon isolates the same accepted chair and flag.
logo.clear_space: At least half the symbol height on every side; 12px around a 24px mark
logo.placement: Primary in landing navigation and demo chrome; light monochrome in green landing footer; icon favicon on both pages

graphic_language.medium: Designed picture-day envelope collage: bright documentary soccer photographs, crisp cut-paper shapes, assertive condensed typography and package labels; clean daylight packshots for catalogue objects.
graphic_language.motif: Folding-chair back and clipped ticket corner, repeated only on offer panels and image-package divisions.
graphic_language.composition: 1248px maximum, 24px mobile gutters (16px at 320px), 64px desktop gutters; horizontal chair-height rules; open feature passages; supporting compositions shown uncropped.
graphic_language.texture: Subtle uncoated order-envelope grain within generated graphic artworks; flat clean HTML surfaces.
